note: Set A binds the shower-pan buildup, substrate slope, glass tile dimensions and porcelain tile thickness correctly and with only one clear error (the 3/8" porcelain wall tile is attributed to Laundry Millwork Detail D5, when it belongs to the backsplash detail D3). Set B captures the D3 and D5 scales and the edge strip that A omits, but it introduces more defects: it reads the grid line 'E' as a slope direction, gives an unsupported generic 'drawing | scale' on a sheet that carries two different scales, and adds vague PT1 'finish paint'/'surface finish' claims. Both sets duplicate facts (slope, tile thickness, copyright/lot) and both omit the 1/2" gypsum wallboard, 3/4" MDF gable and steel L-bracket. On balance A is the cleaner, better-bound set despite B's slightly wider coverage.
remarks: Both extractions leave out several labelled assembly items visible in the details: 1/2" GYPSUM WALLBOARD, 3/4" MDF GABLE FIN. W/ P3, STEEL L-BRACKET ATTACHMENT and BLOCKING AS REQ'D. The text layer drops the grid/zone letters context, which likely caused B's 'direction E' error; PT1 is a finish/paint key mark, so claims naming a specific attribute ('finish paint', 'surface finish') are speculative. Set A also repeats the same slope fact under two entity names and the lot number/copyright under both 'document' and 'sheet'/'project'.
